text.tspan: Final-year Computer Science student at Taylor's University, majoring in Artificial Intelligence. I build
LLM applications, mostly RAG pipelines and agentic workflows. I've led development on several team
projects, from a procurement fraud platform to hackathon builds in logistics and healthcare, and made
the Dean's List five semesters in a row. Right now I'm going deeper on agent frameworks, LLM evaluation
and fine-tuning. I'm looking for an AI/ML engineering internship where I can ship LLM features to real
